title: Desi Delight
body:
# Welcome to Desi Delight!
## About
This is an addon for Farmer's Delight, bringing an Indian cuisine expansion to Minecraft!
This mod is still in development, with many foods and features to be added eventually (see: future updates), so keep in mind that you may run into issues.
Please credit me or link back to this page if you intend to use this mod in modpacks!


## Dependencies
Make sure the Minecraft versions match!
### Farmer's Delight
[Farmer's Delight](https://modrinth.com/mod/farmers-delight)


## Compatibilities
### JEI
[Just Enough Items](https://modrinth.com/mod/jei)

## Future Updates
Here's some things I wish to do for this mod in the future : 
- Port to Neoforge and 1.21.1, and possibly even Fabric (although right now I have no plans to backport to 1.18/1.19)
- New structures for a more intuitive experience using the Tandoor
- 3D display Models for most non-feast food
- Add a LOT more food from Indian cuisine, and eventually expand to Pakistan, Bangladesh, Sri Lanka, Nepal, and more countries' cuisines as well!
- Add in more decorational features related to Desi culture!
Any suggestions? Add an idea to the repository's discussion page!
